name: County Durham Foodbank - Bishop Auckland
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Bishop Auckland
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Bishop Auckland distribution point at Belvedere House

name: Woodhouse Close Allotments
short_description: Allotment site for growing your own food
description: Bishop Auckland Town Council manages 8 allotment sites including Woodhouse Close off Woodhouse Lane. Plots available for rent for growing vegetables and fruit. Open daily during daylight hours.

name: Incredible Edible Bishop Auckland
short_description: Community growing project with public access food gardens
description: Incredible Edible project growing fruit and vegetables in public spaces around Bishop Auckland. Supported by The Auckland Project. Produce is free for anyone to harvest. Open access sites throughout town.
